description.p: ImgConvert converts batches of JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images with a Rust in-process image pipeline.
The Flatpak main package disables optional external codec helpers by default. HEIC/HEIF helper plugins are intentionally not bundled.

screenshot.caption: Batch image conversion queue and output settings

description.p: Improves conversion path handling and release reliability across supported platforms.
Normalizes AppImage launcher permissions for sandboxed catalog validation.
Includes complete AUR submission metadata in the downloadable release artifact.
Fixes Snap builds by sanitizing the GNOME SDK environment and enabling Tauri's embedded production frontend.
Provides the Rustup build dependency required by the Snapcraft Rust plugin on all supported architectures.
Aligns all Linux package builders with the Ubuntu 22.04 compatibility baseline and fixes tool detection on that baseline.
Adds strict Snap packaging, an Ubuntu 22.04 AppImageHub compatibility baseline, and reproducible AUR package metadata.
Raises the arm64 Mac App Store deployment target to macOS 12 and supplies the required 1024-pixel application icon while retaining the existing sandbox and local-processing boundaries.
Adds Chinese and English interface localization, structured localized conversion errors, and release-channel hardening while retaining the Flatpak main package's external-codec boundary.
Initial Linux release candidate with JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and optional external HEIC import boundaries.
